scope.decision: The documented basic mode provides individual button LEDs, performance-pad LEDs, FX LEDs, meters, and touchstrip light-guide output. M4 has no established requirement for advanced mode.

evidenceClasses.physical: Requires a captured M4 observation unless explicitly marked measured

singleColor.documented: 0 through 16 selects intensity; 0 is off, 16 is full; values above 16 are full intensity

bicolor.documented: low four bits select intensity 0 through 15; color offsets are red 0x00, amber 0x40, green 0x70
bicolor.m4FunctionalPolicy: Use documented off value 0 for inactive and documented full-color values for active. Historical dim-inactive styling is deferred polish.

controllerV1Closure.alternatePagePolicy: Mirror stateful PLAY, PFL, FADER FX, quantize, keylock, sync, loop and hot-cue feedback. Map alternate-page CUE to reverse, ADJUST/SLIP to slip_enabled, and AUTOLOOP pads to the documented shifted loop sizes.
controllerV1Closure.physicalResult: Deck A/B state buttons, deck-B parity, normal and alternate hot-cue state, AUTOLOOP state, MASTER FX assignment/enable, momentary beatgrid ADJUST and persistent SHIFT+SLIP all passed live visual verification.
